name: Ticket Triage Assistant
summary: Automatically classifies Zendesk tickets by urgency and team, drafts replies for simple issues, and flags VIP tickets for escalation.

items.title: Fetch incoming Zendesk tickets
items.description: Retrieves new tickets from Zendesk so they can be processed.
items.proved_when: New tickets appear in the system within one minute of being created in Zendesk.

items.title: Classify ticket urgency and team
items.description: Reads each ticket and assigns an urgency level (low, medium, high) and the responsible team.
items.proved_when: Every ticket has an urgency label (low, medium, high) and a team label visible in its details.
items.source_quote: Classify incoming Zendesk tickets by urgency and team

items.title: Draft a reply for simple tickets
items.description: When a ticket is marked as simple, creates a suggested reply that agents can review and send.
items.proved_when: Tickets marked as simple show a draft reply in the ticket notes.
items.source_quote: draft a reply for simple ones

items.title: Escalate VIP tickets to Slack
items.description: When a ticket comes from a VIP customer, posts a notification to a designated Slack channel with ticket details.
items.proved_when: VIP tickets trigger a message in the Slack channel within two minutes.
